systems.system: Hospital network over DFN fibre (Ali Sabieh regional hospital linked to other hospitals)
systems.platform: World Bank-financed Djibouti Fondations Numeriques fibre network
systems.owner: Ministry of Communication in charge of Posts and Telecommunications (project lead)

note: Describes fibre connectivity letting the Ali Sabieh hospital share patient files with Peltier hospital specialists; names no health information systems exchanging data, so no fact for the exchange class.

States HIS limitations and an intention to seek resources to revamp the data system and ensure national data connectivity; no exchange contracted, being built or in service, and DHIS2 is a single system.
